title: Ceph cluster
description: The Ceph cluster: health checks, capacity, throughput, PG states, latency, versions. Derived from ceph-mixin v20.2.4; provisioned from git (kube-cluster/apps/grafana/dashboards/ceph), the README there has the runbook.

links.title: Servers
links.tooltip: Host metrics of the Ceph nodes (CPU, memory, disks, network)

panels.description: The cluster's health. **Bad:** WARN or ERROR; see *Active health checks* below. **Fix:** per check, `ceph health detail`.
panels.title: Ceph health status

panels.description: Raw capacity not yet used. **Bad:** low; but a single full OSD blocks writes long before this reaches 0 (see *OSD fullness*). **Fix:** add OSDs or free data.
panels.title: Available Capacity

panels.description: OSD counts. **Bad:** Down or Out above 0. **Fix:** `ceph osd tree`; restart the daemon or check its disk and host.
panels.title: OSDs

panels.description: Active and standby managers. **Bad:** no active, or no standby. **Fix:** `ceph orch ps --daemon-type mgr`.
panels.title: MGRs

panels.description: Active Ceph health checks by severity (`ceph_health_detail`). **Bad:** any error; read *Active health checks* below. **Fix:** each check's cause is in `ceph health detail`; the runbook is in the Grafana README.
panels.title: Health checks

panels.description: Monitors in quorum. **Bad:** fewer than total; below a majority the cluster stops. **Fix:** the monitor's host, clock sync (`MON_CLOCK_SKEW`), disk space.
panels.title: Monitors
Active health checks
panels.description: Every Ceph health check that is raised now, from `ceph_health_detail`. `AUTH_INSECURE_*` are known and accepted. **Fix:** `ceph health detail` for the affected objects; the Grafana README maps checks to causes.

panels.title: OSD fullness against the full ratios
panels.description: Fullest OSD and the cluster average against the `nearfull` and `full` ratios (`backfillfull` lies between and is not exported). **Bad:** the fullest OSD near `nearfull`: warnings; past `backfillfull` backfill stops; at `full` writes to its PGs stop. **Fix:** free space or add OSDs, then `ceph osd reweight-by-utilization`; raising the ratios only buys time.

panels.title: Fullest OSDs
panels.description: The ten fullest OSDs. A skewed distribution fills the cluster before the average says so.

panels.title: Grafana alerts
panels.description: The rules in the Ceph alert folder (rule group `ext-ceph`) that are firing or pending.
